hook.text: A single DNA letter swaps. Just one. It seems trivial—until that one change builds a different protein.

buildup.text: Point mutations come in three types: silent, missense, and nonsense. Silent ones change nothing.

discovery.text: Missense mutations swap one amino acid for another. Nonsense mutations create a premature stop signal.

twist.text: A nonsense mutation in the dystrophin gene causes Duchenne muscular dystrophy. One stop sign in the wrong place.

climax.text: Point mutations are the smallest possible genetic change—yet they drive diseases, adaptations, and evolution.

punchline.text: One letter. One protein. One life changed.

quiz.question: What does a nonsense mutation do?
